examples.japanese: {履歴書|りれきしょ}を{書|か}いて{会社|かいしゃ}に{送|おく}った。
examples.english: I wrote a resume and sent it to the company.

examples.japanese: {履歴書|りれきしょ}には{写真|しゃしん}を{貼|は}る{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to attach a photo to your resume.

examples.japanese: {手書|てが}きの{履歴書|りれきしょ}を{求|もと}める{会社|かいしゃ}もある。

notes:
{履歴書|りれきしょ} is the standard Japanese resume format with a specific structure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}を{書|か}く (to write a resume)
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する (to submit a resume)
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}を{送|おく}る (to send a resume)
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}{用紙|ようし} (resume form)

JAPANESE RESUME FEATURES:
- Standard format sold at convenience stores
- Requires photo (typically formal 3x4cm)
- Some companies prefer {手書|てが}き (handwritten)
- Includes personal details, education, work history

RELATED DOCUMENTS:
- {職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ} (work history document - more detailed)
- {添{そ}え{状|じょう}  (cover letter)
- {自己|じこ}PR (self-promotion statement)

definitions.gloss: resume, curriculum vitae (CV), personal history document
